title: Rust-Mote Drone
text: A maintenance mote jitters from its cradle, welding sparks at ankle height while its logic wheel spins in panic.
flavor: It remembers repair. It has forgotten permission.

defeatReward.text: You pin the mote and salvage its still-warm route bearing.

imagePrompt: Tiny malfunctioning brass repair drone spraying orange welding sparks near a cracked transit gate, low-tier machine enemy, dark industrial board-game card art
